types.name: Coins and dice
types.description: One or more coins are tossed or dice are thrown, and the question asks about heads, tails, the number shown, a sum, a product or a doublet.

types.name: Playing cards
types.description: One or more cards are drawn from a pack of 52 cards, and the question asks about suits, colours, kings, queens, face cards or aces.

types.name: Balls and marbles
types.description: Balls, marbles or other items of different colours are taken from a bag, box or jar, one or more at a time.

types.name: Independent events and at least one
types.description: Two or more people or events have their own probabilities given (hitting a target, solving a problem, speaking the truth) and the question asks for both, neither, at least one, or a contradiction.

types.name: Numbers, letters and calendars
types.description: A number is picked from a range (such as 1 to 50), a letter from a word, or a day from a year, and the question asks about multiples, primes, vowels or 53 Sundays.
